articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Huáng Kēzhǎng, nín xiàge Xīngqīliù yǒu gōngfu ma?
MR. ANDERSON: Section Chief Huáng, are you free Saturday of next week?
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Yǒu. Yǒu shénme shì ma?
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: Yes. Is there something?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nín dào wǒmen jiā lái chī ge biànfàn.
MR. ANDERSON: I'd like to invite you to our house for a simple meal.
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Nín hébì zhème kèqi?
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: Why is it necessary to be so polite?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Bú shi kèqi. Wǒ yǒu yíge péngyou gāng cóng Měiguo lái.
MR. ANDERSON: It's not politeness. I have a friend who has just come from America.
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Nà tài hǎo le! Hěn xīwàng gēn ta tántan.
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: That's wonderful! I'd very much like to talk with her.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Liùdiǎn bàn duì nín fāngbian bu fāngbian?
MR. ANDERSON: Would six-thirty be convenient for you?
HUÁNG KĒZHǍNG: Fāngbian, fāngbian. Nà jiù xiān xiè le.
SECTION CHIEF HUÁNG: That would be fine. Well then, thank you in advance.
